repo.description: Watched repository as owner/name — REQUIRED per deployment. Drives the webhook repo filter and the status-event repo check.

webhook_secret_env.description: Env var holding this repo's webhook HMAC secret — the BUPHA_WH_<OWNER>_<REPO> convention (uppercased, '-' → '_'). REQUIRED per deployment; the var must exist in the campaign service env (~/.config/peregrin/env or cuora).

checkout.description: Local clone path lasius operates on — REQUIRED per deployment.

node_url.description: Base URL of `peregrin serve` (sessions + entity plane). Default http://127.0.0.1:18787.

worktree_base.description: Detached heal worktrees and the per-PR attempt ledger land here.

agent.description: sepia agent-config id for fix sessions.

agent_mode.description: ACP session mode applied after create (session/set_mode). REQUIRED for unattended runs — devin's default accept-edits prompts on exec and deadlocks. 'bypass' auto-approves all tools; 'smart' auto-runs model-judged-safe actions; 'accept-edits' only auto-approves edits.

max_agent_attempts.description: Per-PR cap on agent heal attempts — counted in <worktree_base>/attempts/pr-<n>, durable across restarts.

max_conflict_attempts.description: Per-PR cap on merge-conflict resolution attempts — counted in <worktree_base>/attempts/pr-<n>-conflicts, durable across restarts. Over-cap emits conflict.attempts.gaveup and leaves the PR for a human.

ci_check_name.description: check_run.name the campaign reacts to (the CI job name).

default_branch.description: Default branch — only pushes to it enqueue ci-jobs; PR branches are covered by pull_request events.

lasius_root.description: lasius workspace root (--root flag); repo args are checkout paths so any lasius.toml workspace works.
